items.title: Susceptible
items.text:
Susceptible: When you begin your turn in an
infested city (rat), get exposed twice instead of once.

mechanics.trigger: When you begin your turn in an infested city
mechanics.effect: Get exposed twice instead of once.
mechanics.infestedIcon: green rat in parentheses, the same rat as the door 50 stickers

items.title: Fear of Needles
items.text:
Fear of Needles: You cannot do the Inoculate
free action.

mechanics.effect: You cannot do the Inoculate free action.

items.title: Fear of Flying
items.text:
Fear of Flying: You must discard a Player card (if you
have one) when you do the Shuttle Flight action.

mechanics.trigger: When you do the Shuttle Flight action
mechanics.effect: You must discard a Player card if you have one.
restrictions: Discard only if you have a Player card

items.title: SCARS
items.text:
SCARS
Add these to your pool of scars.

mechanics.effect: Add these stickers to the pool of scars.

summary: Three scars for the pool: Susceptible (an infested-city start exposes you twice; the mark is a green rat), Fear of Needles (you cannot Inoculate), and Fear of Flying (Shuttle Flight discards a Player card if you have one). The SCARS label is byte-identical to door 47.
